findings.summary: ShellPane._signal_pins (and _OwnedSession._kill_owned_session) catch only ProcessLookupError. A session member the user may not signal (EPERM) makes kill() raise PermissionError; kill_pane only maps UnsafeShellState, UiServer._handle only catches Held, so the exception leaves ui.poll -> _tick -> _loop and run() treats it as 'backend failure' and closes every pane.
findings.failure_scenario: Host shell runs `sudo apt upgrade` / `sudo tail -f ...` (sudo's own process becomes full root and stays in the caller's session), an interactive `su -`/`su otheruser` shell (same session without --pty), `pkexec cmd`, or sudo with !use_pty. User presses Ctrl-] k, k. pidfd_open pins the root member (no permission needed), pidfd_send_signal(SIGHUP) -> EPERM -> PermissionError escapes -> backend exits and both OMP sessions are terminated, contrary to C-D63 'backend, OMP pane은 그대로다'. The remaining pins after the failing one are never signalled in that round. Same root cause on the restart path: a pinned unsignalable leftover makes old.close() raise in _restart_shell, so restart_pane returns restart_failed on every retry while that process lives (shell cannot be restarted). Reproduced with a one-shot EPERM mock: kill_pane raised PermissionError (not Held).
findings.fix_hint: Treat PermissionError (EPERM) per member as 'not signalable': skip it, keep going with the other pins, report it in survivors/left reasons; never let OSError escape kill()/close()/_kill_owned_session; kill_pane maps any remaining OSError to Held(KILL_FAILED). Add a test with an EPERM member (mock) for kill, restart-after-exit and close.

findings.summary: Restart of an exited host shell SIGKILLs the members still left in the old session (pinned at exit, e.g. `nohup job &` then Ctrl-d) without the user being told; C-D63 (1) only says 'Enter로 새 shell 시작' and the UI notice/contract text do not mention it.
findings.failure_scenario: User runs `nohup long_build >log 2>&1 &`, exits the shell with Ctrl-d, later presses Enter in the exited pane: the build is SIGKILLed by old.close() -> _kill_owned_session. Consistent with the OMP restart (C-D62) and with pre-change shutdown, but it is an undisclosed user-visible effect of the restart.
findings.fix_hint: Either disclose it (notice/contract/ticket text) or have Root confirm the intended behaviour.

findings.summary: While the confirmation is open, any Passthrough whose first byte is k/K/Ctrl-k confirms and drops the rest, so a multi-byte unbracketed read (typeahead, auto-repeat, a paste delivered without bracketed-paste markers by an outer multiplexer) beginning with 'k' confirms the kill.
findings.failure_scenario: Ctrl-] k opens the modal; the outer terminal/multiplexer pastes 'kubectl get pods' without ESC[200~ markers (or k is held/auto-repeats): event Passthrough(b'kubectl...') -> data[:1]==b'k' -> kill_pane sent. Bracketed paste, mouse, resize and IME paths are correctly safe; this follows the Root-specified 'k-forms confirm' rule, so it is a residual-risk note.
findings.fix_hint: Optionally confirm only when the event is exactly one key (b'k', b'K', b'\x0b' or the jamo form) and cancel on longer Passthrough data.

findings.summary: After a kill that closed a manager request, the dead shell's state keeps request_id with phase 'unknown', so _active_work/shutdown_request still list a 'shell_request' as active work until the shell is restarted.
findings.failure_scenario: Manager command in flight -> kill_pane -> before Enter-restart the user detaches and runs shutdown: the shutdown prompt reports an active shell_request for a shell that no longer exists (cosmetic; the record correctly says outcome unknown).
findings.fix_hint: Skip shell active work when self.shell.exited().

focus_verdicts.kill_semantics: block (R1). Otherwise sound: signals only through pidfds pinned while the unreaped parent proves the session (no recycled PID), HUP/TERM/CONT to all members incl. ones forked meanwhile, KILL after 1 s grace via _kill_owned_session, setsid processes never targeted and reported in left_session, unprovable identity -> kill_failed with nothing signalled, manager in-flight request closed as unknown (fail_unknown, never control_returned) before any signal, refusals correct. Loop stall bounded (~1 s grace + <=2 s KILL rounds + <=1 s reap wait; observed 1.07 s live); UI shows 'host terminal 강제 종료 중…' meanwhile.
